page_mapping: outlook-report.pdf: PDF page = printed page + 3; case-descriptions.pdf: PDF page = printed page + 4

checkpoints.where: outlook-report.pdf printed p4 (PDF p7) footnote 3; Foreword PDF p4 'not a set of predictions'
checkpoints.value: 'It should not be regarded as the most likely of the cases.' Reference case renamed Counterfactual Baseline.

checkpoints.where: tables/*_table8.xlsx Total Electricity Use; report p14 (PDF p17) 0.9%–1.6%/yr; p15–16 (PDF p18–19) 25%–50%
checkpoints.note: [2025 BkWh, 2050 BkWh, growth %, CAGR %]. Low end AltTrnp, high end HighElDmd.

checkpoints.where: tables/*_table8.xlsx End-Use Prices (2025 cents) vs (nominal cents); table20 GDP chain-type price index
checkpoints.note: [2050 real 2025¢, 2050 nominal ¢, deflator 2050]. Low Economic Growth has a much higher price index path (3.27 vs 2.28) so its nominal price (~31.9¢) ranks highest while its real price (~13.6¢) is among the lowest.

checkpoints.where: table8 All Sectors Average (2025 cents); table1 Henry Hub (2025 dollars per MMBtu); report p16 (PDF p19) gas–power price correlation; p18 (PDF p21) $3 / $10 per MMBtu real 2025
checkpoints.note: [2050 avg price 2025¢/kWh, 2050 Henry Hub 2025$/MMBtu]. figure-data.xlsx sheet 17_HHnatgasspot labels Henry Hub only 'U.S. dollars per million British thermal units' (no dollar year); values equal table1 2025-dollar row. 1 MMBtu = 293.07 kWh.

checkpoints.topic: Data-centre server electricity: report vs case descriptions
checkpoints.where: outlook-report.pdf printed p14 (PDF p17): 818 BkWh HighElDmd 2050, 84% above baseline; figure-data.xlsx 7_DataCenters (2050: CB 445.6, HighElDmd 818.7 BkWh; 2020 = 49.4); case-descriptions.pdf printed p8 (PDF p12) Table 3: 800 / 1,440 TWh/yr
checkpoints.note: TWh = billion kWh, so the two documents give different magnitudes for what is labelled server energy consumption; ratios agree (~1.8). '16 times 2020' in the report checks out against figure data (818.7/49.4=16.6).

checkpoints.topic: kWh ↔ quads; delivered vs incl. losses
checkpoints.where: table2 Purchased Electricity, Delivered Energy, Electricity-Related Losses, Total; table8 sales
checkpoints.note: 3,412 Btu/kWh reproduces Table 2 purchased electricity to <0.1%.

checkpoints.where: report printed p12 (PDF p15) '9% less electricity sales'; table8
table8 Total Net Electricity Generation by Fuel; report p16 (PDF p19) ~40% gas, 20% wind, 20% solar
case-descriptions.pdf printed pp4–8 (PDF pp8–12); report pp4–5 (PDF pp7–8)

value.AltTrnp: removes EPA MY2027+ LDV GHG, Phase 3 truck GHG and low-NOx truck standards
value.AltElec: removes April 2024 CAA s.111 power-plant CO2 rule
value.High/LowOGS: EUR, undiscovered resources and technology rates ±50%
value.High/LowZTC: zero-carbon capital costs frozen / 40% below baseline by 2050

checkpoints.value: 1.6%/yr vs 1.5%/yr in report text; tables give 1.65% and 1.57%; HighElDmd increment is commercial-only by design.

checkpoints.where: table20 'Real Gross Domestic Product' (billion chained 2012 dollars); report p7 (PDF p10) 'trillion 2012 dollars'; case-descriptions Table 2 (PDF p8)
table8 Prices by Service Category; report p15 (PDF p18)
